environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy contains a principal condition restricting invoke access to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FrontendServiceRole only. Callers must present valid SigV4 signatures from the authorized role. The frontend service (an ECS task assuming FrontendServiceRole) extracts the authenticated user's sub claim from Cognito JWT, injects it as 'authenticated_user_id' in the request body, and overwrites any user-supplied 'user_id' field before forwarding to the Lambda Function URL. The ECS task's IAM task role has sts:AssumeRole permission scoped only to FrontendServiceRole. CloudTrail logs all lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl calls. Note: the Lambda code itself does not validate the caller identity — the architectural assumption is that only the frontend service can invoke it, and the frontend normalizes the user_id field.

config.frontend_behavior: ECS service overwrites user_id in request body with authenticated Cognito sub before SigV4-signed invocation
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, Function URL only accessible via IAM-authenticated calls
config.cloudtrail: enabled for lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl with source identity logging
